clue.text: Red Book's dosh distributed, when dividing swag

explanation.walkthrough: 'springing up' turns EX + O into OXE; 'roots' puts YE at the foot of this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: The oxeye daisy is a common white-petalled wild flower of meadows.

explanation.definitionFit: The end of the world is when, in Christian belief, all are judged, the last day.

clue.text: Song sung with not so much feeling

explanation.definitionFit: An auctioneer calls this before the hammer falls, ending bidding on a lot.

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise at something being struck while someone drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Good Heavens!' reads as one oath but splits into two pieces, the first in French.
explanation.definitionFit: A hand drum is an instrument struck with the fingers, so it is something that gets beaten.

clue.text: Exercise time, though taking a quick look over one's shoulder?

explanation.definitionFit: A full-length cinema film is described this way, and Roxanne is one, with a nose's size at its heart.

taken as written
